scope: Audit fixes and reconstruction of an earlier experiment; current local checks and historical runtime results are separate.

current_changes.source_commit_basis: Fixes locally qualified; final commit, CI and deployment are managed separately.
bugs_fixed: Trusted Host/Origin and authenticated explicit LAN access.
Fresh Eyes required behavioral briefs and legacy resume repair.
Byte-based evidence pruning before SQLite capacity.
Local failures do not trigger paid model fallbacks.
current_changes.cadence_guidance: Patterns after meaningful changes; Fresh Eyes at milestones and regularly on active projects; CI when component or pipeline assumptions change.
current_changes.deduplication: Removed duplicated helper, facade, planner and workflow machinery.

historical_run.analysis_effort_basis: Not independently recorded in the analysis call ledger; blank model configuration inherits runtime defaults.
historical_run.meaning_of_51: Successful MCP calls during the ranking milestone only; neither whole-run tool count nor model-call count.
other_failure_categories: Completed Pattern result rejected after snapshot became stale.
Workflow starts rejected while another workflow was active.
Inspection of an entity outside the graph.

limitations: The historical runtime predates these fixes; its failures and outputs are not current-version qualification.
Thirty-four means recorded completed/failed analysis outcomes. Unfinished calls may have no recorded outcome.
Summed elapsed times include concurrent calls and are not workflow or application wall time.
All recorded dollar costs are unknown; token usage for three failed annotation outcomes is unknown.
Saved artifact bytes are not MCP wire-reply sizes; bounded historical logs cannot reconstruct those replies.
Tool consultation and agent-authored adoption narratives do not establish independent recommendation-to-patch linkage or architectural benefit.
One matched pair, coding timeouts and missing resource data do not establish a causal advantage or a cost comparison.
Dependency observations, including newly captured types/imports, remain incomplete.

questions: What time and cost did using the tool add?
